SafeSight AI: Corporate PPE Safety Manual (v4.2) 1.0 SCOPE AND MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS All employees, contractors, and site visitors must wear approved Type 1 Class E industrial hardhats at all times while present inside designated active construction and fabrication zones. High-visibility safety vests with reflective striping must be worn by all personnel working within 15 meters of vehicle traffic or heavy mechanical plant. Safety glasses or goggles complying with ANSI Z87.1 standard are strictly mandatory in areas where cutting, grinding, or chemical splashing hazards exist. Puncture-resistant, steel-toed safety boots are required across the entire industrial perimeter. Sneakers or open-toed footwear are strictly prohibited. 2.0 PPE CARE AND INSPECTION Workers shall inspect all personal protective equipment daily prior to commencement of work. Any hardhat subjected to severe impact must be immediately decommissioned and discarded.

Industrial Hot Work & Welding Safety Handbook 1.0 PPE REQUIREMENTS FOR WELDING OPERATIONS What PPE is required for welding: Operators must wear shade 10-12 welding helmets with auto-darkening filters, flame-retardant split cowhide leather welding jackets or aprons, heat-resistant welding gloves, and safety goggles underneath the helmet at all times. Synthetic clothing like polyester or nylon is prohibited near open arc welding due to severe melting hazards. 2.0 PROCEDURE FOR CONFINED SPACE ENTRY Step 1: Obtain a valid Confined Space Entry Permit signed by the appointed Safety Officer. Step 2: Test atmospheric conditions for oxygen levels (19.5% to 23.5%), flammable gases ( 10% LEL), and toxic contaminants. Step 3: Establish continuous forced mechanical ventilation throughout the work period. Step 4: Wear a full body harness connected to a mechanical retrieval tripod system. Step 5: Maintain a dedicated standby attendant outside the entrance at all times.

SOP-042: Safe Operation of Portable Angle Grinders 1.0 PURPOSE AND PPE PREREQUISITES Operators must verify that the wheel guard is properly fitted and securely tightened before connecting power. Full face shield, safety goggles, leather gloves, and hearing protection must be worn at all times. 2.0 OPERATING PROCEDURE Step 1: Visually inspect grinding disc for cracks, chips, or excessive wear before startup. Step 2: Clamp workpiece firmly to workbench; holding workpieces by hand is prohibited. Step 3: Allow the grinder to reach full operating speed before contacting the material. Step 4: Maintain two-handed grip on grinder body and auxiliary handle throughout cutting.

Synthetic clothing like polyester or nylon is prohibited near open arc welding due to severe melting hazards. 2.0 PROCEDURE FOR CONFINED SPACE ENTRY Step 1: Obtain a valid Confined Space Entry Permit signed by the appointed Safety Officer. Step 2: Test atmospheric conditions for oxygen levels (19.5% to 23.5%), flammable gases ( 10% LEL), and toxic contaminants. Step 3: Establish continuous forced mechanical ventilation throughout the work period. Step 4: Wear a full body harness connected to a mechanical retrieval tripod system. Step 5: Maintain a dedicated standby attendant outside the entrance at all times.

SOP-042: Safe Operation of Portable Angle Grinders 1.0 PURPOSE AND PPE PREREQUISITES Operators must verify that the wheel guard is properly fitted and securely tightened before connecting power. Full face shield, safety goggles, leather gloves, and hearing protection must be worn at all times. 2.0 OPERATING PROCEDURE Step 1: Visually inspect grinding disc for cracks, chips, or excessive wear before startup. Step 2: Clamp workpiece firmly to workbench; holding workpieces by hand is prohibited. Step 3: Allow the grinder to reach full operating speed before contacting the material. Step 4: Maintain two-handed grip on grinder body and auxiliary handle throughout cutting.
